media:group.media:title: Becoming Rocky with Anthony Ippolito
media:group.media:description:
_I Play Rocky_ star Anthony Ippolito breaks down everything he did to become Sylvester Stallone in the biographical drama which follows the development and production of _Rocky_ (1976). The American actor talks through every step of his journey towards becoming Rocky: from speaking with Stallone before filming to packing on lean mass to match Rocky’s iconic physique.
#Rocky #SylvesterStallone #AnthonyIppolito

entry.title: Matt Damon: The Truth Behind 'Hollywood's List'

media:group.media:title: Matt Damon: The Truth Behind 'Hollywood's List'
media:group.media:description:
With _The Odyssey,_ lightning struck twice for Matt Damon. _Good Will Hunting_ is considered sui generis, without precedent. To add Christopher Nolan’s epic onto your resume almost 30 years on is rarefied air. Now, at the tail end of year spearheaded by a $1.8 billion box office and punctuated by seven separate film projects, Matt finds himself winding down. Here Damon chats with GQ’s Frazier Tharpe about the intricacies filming everything for _The Odyssey_ in IMAX, the pressures of the Oscars, and the role that got away.
